create_image_to_text_input: create an ImageToTextInput with image data and optional generation parameters
build_image_to_text_output: build an ImageToTextOutput from generated text returned by the inference API
configure_generation_parameters: configure ImageToTextGenerationParameters with sampling, beam search, and token limits
set_inference_parameters: set ImageToTextParameters with generation options and max token count for image-to-text
use_early_stopping_enum: use ImageToTextEarlyStoppingEnum literal to control beam search stopping behavior
